headline: Executive order removes more federal workplaces from the program that lets federal employees bargain through labor unions.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order adds more federal agencies or offices to the list of those excluded from the Federal Labor-Management Relations Program. That program sets the rules for how unions represent federal workers and bargain with agencies. Workers in the newly excluded offices would likely lose the ability to bargain collectively under that program. The title does not say which agencies are covered.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees in the newly excluded agencies or offices
who_it_affects.how: They would likely no longer be covered by union contracts or collective bargaining rights under the federal labor-management program.

who_it_affects.group: Labor unions that represent federal workers
who_it_affects.how: They would likely lose the right to bargain on behalf of employees in the excluded workplaces.

who_it_affects.group: Managers at the affected federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: They would likely set work rules without negotiating with unions under the program.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the available information; executive orders usually take effect when signed, which was August 28, 2025.
